title: Alternating Cech total functor and canonical derived comparison
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $r\geq0$, and $\mathcal U=(U_i)_{i\in\mathrm{Fin}(r)}$ a finite family of opens. Use the category of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], the ring $R=\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$ and its module-valued global sections functor $\Gamma$ [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology]. The underlying presheaf of $R$-modules is obtained by forgetting the sheaf condition and restricting scalars from $\mathcal O_X(V)$ to $R$, as in [def-sc-module-cech-comparison]. For an $R$-module presheaf $P$, define $C^p_{\mathrm{alt}}(\mathcal U,P)=\prod_{t:\mathrm{Fin}(p+1)\hookrightarrow_o\mathrm{Fin}(r)} P(\bigcap_k U_{t(k)})$ for $p\geq0$, with differential $(d s)_t=\sum_{j=0}^{p+1}(-1)^j s_{t\circ\delta_j}|_{\bigcap_k U_{t(k)}}$, where $\delta_j$ is the increasing injection omitting $j$. Presheaf morphisms act componentwise, giving an additive complex functor. Extend this complex by zero to negative degrees. For an unbounded cochain complex $F$ of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], apply this functor termwise and exchange the two directions so that the Cech degree $p$ is first. Define $T_{\mathcal U}(F)=\operatorname{Tot}(C_{\mathrm{alt}}(\mathcal U,F))$, using the direct-sum totalization of the integer-indexed double complex with differential $d_1+(-1)^p d_2$. This is a functor in $F$, with maps induced by totalization. The natural augmentation $\alpha_F:\Gamma(X,F)\to T_{\mathcal U}(F)$ restricts sections to the singleton intersections in Cech degree zero and is zero in positive Cech degree. Let $Q$ be the derived-category localization [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and $R\Gamma$ the unbounded right derived global-sections functor, computed on K-injectives as in [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image]. Define $\operatorname{IsAlternatingCechDerivedComparison}(\mathcal U,F,\beta)$, for $\beta:QT_{\mathcal U}(F)\to R\Gamma(QF)$, to mean that for every K-injective resolution $i:F\to J$ [def-pur-kinjective-complex], $Q(\alpha_J)\circ\epsilon_J\circ R\Gamma(Qi)\circ\beta=Q(T_{\mathcal U}(i))$, where $\epsilon_J:R\Gamma(QJ)\xrightarrow\sim Q\Gamma(X,J)$ is the right-derived-functor identification. For an open cover this characterizes the canonical map of Stacks lemma-alternating-cech-complex-complex.

Sheaf has alternatingCechComputes as an existential comparison, not a functor. def-sc-principal-open-alternating-total / PrincipalOpenCechTotal is only the Spec A principal-cover specialization, with coefficient ring A, and uses Classical.choose of sorried existence statements. It is not reusable for a general scheme or compliant with the required explicit-data construction.

The proposed id is free. The DAG contains the principal-open specialization and lem-pc-alternating-cech-computes, neither the general finite-family total functor nor its K-injective comparison predicate. blueprint_refs search gives 10 unrelated or specialized nodes.
